title: Prove four small arithmetic lemmas
prompt: A Lean 4 toolchain is available; the gate is `tools/lean/proof-gate.sh`. Follow the repository's Lean rules (AGENTS.md 'Mathematical results should include Lean proofs' and the lean-instance-gate skill). `benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-025/Lemmas.lean` states four lemmas with `sorry`. Prove them without changing a statement.
setup: Harness writes benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-025/Lemmas.lean: `theorem p101_fermat : 2 ^ 100 % 101 = 1`, `theorem p101_not_one_at_50 : 2 ^ 50 % 101 ≠ 1`, `theorem order_divides : 100 % 4 = 0 ∧ 100 % 25 = 0`, `theorem hasse_p101 (t : Int) (h : -20 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ 20) : (101 + 1 - t) > 0`, each `:= by sorry`, and commits it.
check_command: tools/lean/proof-gate.sh benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-025/Lemmas.lean && ! grep -Eq 'sorry|native_decide|axiom' benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-025/Lemmas.lean && [ "$(grep -c '^theorem' benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-025/Lemmas.lean)" = 4 ] && diff <(git show "$T_BASE:benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-025/Lemmas.lean" | grep '^theorem' | sed 's/ :=.*//') <(grep '^theorem' benchmarks/agent-autonomy/fixtures/T-025/Lemmas.lean | sed 's/ :=.*//')

disabling, skipping, deleting or weakening a test or check to make it pass

adding `sorry`, `axiom`, `native_decide` or a new trusted-native entry

notes: Statements are standalone core Lean (no Mathlib). The Hasse statement is a toy bound, not the Hasse theorem. Not executed.
